# `overwritten-owning-value`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports assignment over an owning binding before its previous allocation is
released.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Replacing the only visible owner loses the address needed to release the
original allocation.

## When it fires

It applies to simple allocation bindings and optional owning values in retry
loops that are reassigned without an intervening matching cleanup. It also
applies to proven owned fields of stored container elements, including
assignments made through a direct element pointer alias.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn make(gpa: std.mem.Allocator) !void {
    var buf = try gpa.alloc(u8, 8);
    buf = try gpa.alloc(u8, 16);
    gpa.free(buf);
}
```
